step.cmd: Fact-find with the client. Refer to the Fact-finding Guide to determine which questions to ask the client.
Determine if the client was contacted during fact-finding:

ul.li: If the client was contacted, go to step 5.
If the client was not contacted or did not reply to the N-10-00-00 letter, go to Client not contacted . Client not contacted

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “Preference or restriction and reasonable period.”
Details: Document the fact-finding details according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy
